n: Surface Mount Remote Temperature Sensor, White (CHVI-RTS-1G-SM-W)
d: CHVI-RTS-1G-SM-W Surface Mount Remote Temperature Sensor, White

specs.label: Construction mounting
specs.value: Attaches to a flat wall surface over a 25 mm (1 inch) round hole, a 1-Gang UK (BS 4662) electrical box, or a 1-Gang European (DIN 49073) electrical box

specs.label: Temperature Tolerance
specs.value: ±0.5° C (±1° F) over full range; +0.1°/-0.4° C (±1° F) at room temperature
